import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample narwhals DataFrame with string user_id and float64 score
native_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [0.95, 0.87, 0.92]
})

df = nw.from_native(native_df, eager_only=True)

# Convert user_id to Int32 and score to Float32
df_converted = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32()),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32())
])

print("Converted DataFrame:")
print(df_converted.to_native())
print("\nSchema:")
print(df_converted.schema)
